card.name: Punctuation before hepatic encephalopathy terms
card.fires_on: Commas and small linking words just before liver-complication terms such as variceal bleeding or hepatic encephalopathy in lists of decompensation events. Also fires inside lactulose and portal-systemic encephalopathy wording.

modes.label: Comma in decompensation lists
modes.description: A comma after ascites or similar, right before the next liver complication.

card.writes: It seems to prepare the model for the next liver complication term, such as encephalopathy, though the promoted tokens are mostly unrelated.
card.plain: It fires at the point in a liver-complication list where the next item, often hepatic encephalopathy, is about to come.
